model_scope: Covers isolated dipole spin-down, inclination decay, wind braking, and simplified binary recycling in a dimensionless ODE/Monte Carlo framework; excludes glitches, magnetospheric state changes, variable moment of inertia, and full observational selection effects.

parameter_requests.meaning: Effective moment of inertia controlling angular momentum response to spin-down torque
required_conditions: representative neutron-star mass and radius equation of state selected
moment of inertia held fixed during a single evolutionary track
retrieval_queries: neutron star moment of inertia from mass-radius relation for selected equation of state and composition
reference database moment of inertia for representative neutron star mass and radius

parameter_requests.meaning: Dimensionless prefactor encoding vacuum dipole torque scaling in the chosen unit system
required_conditions: dimensionless unit system chosen
vacuum dipole torque active
retrieval_queries: modeling convention for dimensionless vacuum dipole spin-down torque prefactor in pulsar evolution models

parameter_requests.meaning: Surface dipole magnetic field strength at the start of the selected evolutionary track
required_conditions: isolated or recycled track initial field specified
surface dipole field approximation used
retrieval_queries: pulsar surface magnetic field measurements from timing surveys
pulsar catalogue magnetic field distribution for isolated pulsars

parameter_requests.meaning: Spin period at the start of the selected evolutionary track
required_conditions: initial spin period before isolated spin-down or after accretion phase specified
birth period distribution or single-track input available
retrieval_queries: pulsar birth period distribution from timing surveys
observed spin period distribution for young pulsars

parameter_requests.meaning: Magnetic inclination angle at the start of the selected evolutionary track
required_conditions: dipole inclination active
isotropic or scenario-specified initial inclination convention used
retrieval_queries: pulsar magnetic inclination angle constraints from emission geometry models

parameter_requests.meaning: Characteristic timescale for magnetic inclination decay when the inclination-decay scenario is active
required_conditions: inclination decay scenario active
exponential inclination decay law selected
retrieval_queries: observed or theoretical pulsar inclination decay timescale
magnetic inclination evolution timescale in pulsar braking models

parameter_requests.meaning: Relative efficiency of particle-wind braking compared with the dipole torque when wind braking is active
required_conditions: wind braking scenario active
constant or scenario-specified wind efficiency convention used
retrieval_queries: pulsar wind braking efficiency from magnetospheric models
braking index deviations attributed to particle wind

parameter_requests.meaning: Dimensionless coefficient scaling the accretion torque during the recycling phase
required_conditions: binary recycling scenario active
standard disk accretion torque approximation used
retrieval_queries: modeling convention for disk accretion torque coefficient in recycled pulsar models

parameter_requests.meaning: Duration of the accretion phase before isolated spin-down in a recycled track
required_conditions: binary recycling scenario active
accretion history simplified to a single duration
retrieval_queries: accretion phase duration for recycled pulsars from binary population models

parameter_requests.meaning: Discrete scenario switch selecting the active torque terms and accretion history
required_conditions: a selected scenario is used for each simulated track
scenario switch controls inclination decay, wind braking, and accretion phase
retrieval_queries: modeling convention for scenario switches in pulsar spin-down population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Model-defined age boundary at which an evolutionary track is truncated
required_conditions: evolutionary integration boundary selected
termination applied when track age reaches the boundary
retrieval_queries: pulsar evolutionary age boundary used in population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Model-defined period-derivative floor below which tracks are truncated for observational comparability
required_conditions: observational truncation boundary selected
termination applied when period derivative falls below the floor
retrieval_queries: pulsar timing survey period derivative detection threshold

scientific_question: Can the joint distribution of braking index n and characteristic age tau_c statistically distinguish isolated magnetic-dipole evolution from binary recycling populations, given specific torque model constraints?
symbolic_constraints: Spin period, surface magnetic field, and period derivative are non-negative.
Inclination is restricted to the physically meaningful aligned-to-perpendicular range.
Moment of inertia is fixed for an individual track.
Braking index and characteristic age are derived diagnostics, not independent states.
Scenario switches select active torque terms without double counting.
Accretion torque is applied only during the recycled scenario.
Monte Carlo sampling must preserve the requested initial-condition and boundary-condition semantics.
Termination rules stop integration when either boundary condition is reached.
symbolic_model_intent: Integrate spin period, magnetic inclination, and surface field under scenario-selected torque terms; derive period derivative, braking index, and characteristic age as diagnostics; optionally sample initial period, field, inclination, and accretion controls with Monte Carlo to form population distributions.
title: Distinguishing Isolated Dipole Evolution from Binary Recycling via Braking Index and Period Derivative Correlations
